scope: Isolated, read-only comparison. No store was restored, imported, pulled, pushed or written; no bead was created, closed or updated for any recovered item.
verdict: None of the 180 bead-shaped ids exists in the live ledger or in any surviving store, history or raw storage chunk examined. Nothing is recoverable from a store; all 180 stay unresolved.

census_183.rule: Distinct matches of astro-plan-[a-z0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)* in full commit messages reachable from the baseline, minus ids present in the recovered 2026-10-02 export, loaded directly from that file. Reproduces the reviewed figure exactly: 243 distinct, 183 absent.
census_183.classification_rule: Bead-shaped: astro-plan- followed by a 3-6 character base36 hash, optionally with numeric .N children, used as a bead reference in context. Non-id: the whole token is a path, repository name or a longer id the pattern truncated.

inferences: [INFERENCE] The August ids were created in a ledger that never committed into the canonical lineage and never pushed: the lineage has zero commits and the remote zero pushes between 2026-07-30 and 2026-09-17, and the 2026-08-26 clone saw the remote at 2026-07-30.

[INFERENCE] The most likely carrier is a per-checkout or per-worktree store that was discarded with its directory. No such store survives on this machine: a search of ~/tmp, ~/personal/dev, /private/tmp, ~/Downloads, ~/scratch, ~/agentic and ~/agentic-scratch found no other platevault store, and no August platevault session transcripts remain.
[INFERENCE] The five astro-plan-wisp-* ids are wisps, which are local-only by design and excluded from exports and remotes, so their absence does not by itself indicate loss.
